title: Category Chain · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Category Chain · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a broad category such as fruits or animals. The lead names three different things in the chosen category without repeating a previous answer. The group agrees all three fit the category. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Category Chain, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group agrees all three fit the category.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The group agrees all three fit the category.
